description: This file defines the 'Theme' class within the Opencart admin event controller namespace. The class handles event-driven tasks related to themes, such as adding, editing, and deleting themes by scheduling background tasks via the setting/task model.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A controller class that manages event hooks related to theme management (add, edit, delete) in the admin panel, scheduling background tasks accordingly.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Handles the event to add a new theme, scheduling a task to generate theme info data.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Handles the event to edit an existing theme, scheduling a task to update theme info.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Handles the event to delete a theme, scheduling a task to perform the deletion.
